assets.subject: Independent harbormaster telescope prop concept
assets.prompt: Create one ORIGINAL stylized fantasy game prop concept from ordinary practical nautical forms: a compact CLOSED collapsible brass spyglass, concentric nested tubes retracted together, with a dark leather grip, secured in a simple practical leather belt sheath with a visible belt loop. Show the whole telescope and sheath together as one compact object in a clear three-quarter view, centered with generous margins on perfectly plain white background. Tactile worn brass and leather, hand-painted game concept art, simple construction legible to a modeler. No person, hands, scenery, unrelated objects, lettering, numerals, symbols, logos, watermark, border or cast shadow. No dimensions. Do not imitate any existing game asset or artist.
